subsets.name: Base
subsets.note: On a single Rainbow foil board. Eight subsets — White, Platinum, Black and Gold, each in series a & b — every one numbered across the four background parallels: 1 Flowing, 2 Stripes, 3 Soccer Ball, 4 Checkered. Autographs are one-of-ones; unsigned base cards are numbered per subset (White a /10, White b /5, Platinum a /3, Platinum b /2, Black a /5, Black b /3, Gold a & b /1). Each card number ends in a player-pose digit after the initials: every subject was captured in two poses, numbered 1 and 2 (e.g. MMSb4-BB1 and MMSb4-BB2 are the two poses of Bradley Barcola).

subsets.name: Premium Base
subsets.note: Three foil boards — Rainbow /5, Lava /3, Gold /1 — each carrying all five parallels. Parallel numbers (1–5) denote background variations. Each card number ends in a player-pose digit after the initials: every subject was captured in two poses, numbered 1 and 2 (e.g. MMPB5-NJ1 and MMPB5-NJ2 are the two poses of Neymar Jr.). Autographs are one-of-ones.

subsets.name: Brushed Oil
subsets.note: Brushed-oil art subset on Rainbow foil in seven variants (a–g). Each card number ends in a player-pose digit after the initials: every subject was captured in four poses, numbered 1 through 4. Every card — signed and unsigned — is a true one-of-one.

subsets.name: Artist Proof
subsets.note: Artist Proof masters on Rainbow foil in five painterly variants. Every card — signed and unsigned — is a true one-of-one.

subsets.name: Dual Autographs
subsets.note: Dual on-card autographs pairing two subjects. Five foil boards — Mirror, Rainbow, Gold, Lava, Mosaic — each a one-of-one.

subsets.name: Triple Autographs
subsets.note: Triple on-card autographs pairing three subjects. Five foil boards — Mirror, Rainbow, Gold, Lava, Mosaic — each a one-of-one.
